title: Record each tab's tokens and cost by model and show the session's estimated cost in its header
prompt:
Nothing tells a person what a session has cost. Record, for every tab, the tokens and estimated cost of each model its agents used, report them from the command line, and show the session's total in its header behind an experimental setting.

The figures come from the agents' own transcripts, read again at every turn end and priced by the same table Stats & Usage uses (src-tauri/src/stats), so a session and Stats agree. Codex can repeat or restart its running token total when a turn opens; each request must be counted once, in Stats and in the session alike. A transcript only grows between turns, so reading it again should not mean parsing it from the start. The totals are kept on the tab in the session index, so the runtime can answer without the window: `terminalx sessions usage <session> [--children-of] --json` reports each tab, the session and a grand total, `sessions list` and `sessions show` carry `estimatedCostUsd` and `estimatedCostUnpricedModels`, and the window's `session_usage` command (`{ sessionId }`) reads the transcripts again and answers `{ usage: SessionUsageReport, session: SessionEntry }`. The header shows what the tabs carry and its popover reads through that command. A model with no price has its tokens counted and its cost left out, never zero, from the stored rows through every total to the header.

Types in src/types/session.ts:
- `ModelUsage { model; inputTokens (uncached); outputTokens; cacheReadTokens; cacheWriteTokens; costUsd: number | null }`, `TabUsage { models: ModelUsage[]; updated: string }`, and `TabEntry.usage?: TabUsage | null`.
- `UsageTotals { inputTokens; outputTokens; cacheReadTokens; cacheWriteTokens; costUsd: number | null; unpricedModels: string[] }`.
- `SessionUsageReport { sessionId; title; tabs: { tabId; title?; agent; models; total: UsageTotals; updated }[]; models; total; estimate: true }`.

The setting: `ExperimentalSettings` in src/lib/api.ts gains `sessionCost?: boolean`, with `experimental.setSessionCost(on)` invoking `set_experimental_settings` with `{ sessionCost }`, and Settings › Experimental gets a Session cost switch. A new src/lib/experimentalSettings.ts holds the settings every view sees: `useExperimentalSettings()` reads `experimental.settings()` once, merges each `experimental_settings_changed` event's payload, and returns null (off) until it knows. It also exports `noteExperimentalSettings(next)` and `resetExperimentalSettingsForTests()`.

src/components/session/SessionCost.tsx exports `SessionCost({ session, className? })`, which SessionView puts in the header before the workspace menu, and `totals`, `formatTokens` and `formatCost`. Of src/lib/api.ts it uses only `experimental.settings` at runtime.
- `totals(rows)` sums the four token counts and the priced rows' cost, and lists each unpriced model once. The cost is null when no row has a price but some row has tokens, and 0 for no rows.
- `formatTokens`: below 1000 as is; below a million rounded thousands (`412k`); then millions with one decimal below ten million (`1.3M`) and none from there (`12M`). `formatCost`: null is `—`; above 0 and below 0.01 is `< $0.01`; from 100 whole dollars (`$123`); otherwise two decimals (`$0.84`, `$0.00`).
- The chip (`data-testid="session-cost"`) shows only while `sessionCost` is true and some tab has a model row. Models are merged by id across tabs, costliest first, unpriced last. Its text is `≈ $0.84`, `≈ $0.13+` when some models have no price, or `≈ —` when none has one. Its title is `Estimated session cost`, or for a partial figure `Estimated session cost, without the models that have no price (claude-new-9)`. Its aria-label is `Session usage: estimated $0.84`, `Session usage: estimated $0.13 and more: no price for claude-new-9`, or `Session usage: no price for its models`.
- A session whose tabs have a `providerSessionId` but no usage yet calls `session_usage` once per session id and passes the answer's `session` to `upsertSession` (src/lib/sessions.ts).
- Clicking the chip opens a popover, a dialog named `Session usage`, and calls `session_usage` again. It holds:
  - `session-usage-billing`: from `checkAgentReadiness(agent).loginMethod` of each agent among the models (an id starting with `claude` is Claude's, any other Codex's). All `Claude account` or `ChatGPT account` gives `subscriptions · nothing billed per token`, all `API key` gives `API key · billed per token`, and anything else `at API list prices`.
  - `session-usage-total`: the total's `formatCost`, labelled `API-equivalent` on subscriptions and `estimate` otherwise.
  - one `session-usage-model` row per model, whose text is its `modelLabel(agent, id)`, then `formatTokens` of input, output, and cache read plus write, then `formatCost`, with nothing between them (`GPT-6.1 Sol38k21k412k$0.71`; an unpriced model ends in `—`).
  - when more than one tab has usage, one `session-usage-tab` row each: `Tab “<title, or the agent's name>”` and that tab's cost.
  - for unpriced models: `No price for claude-new-9: its tokens are counted, its cost is not.`
  - `session-usage-window` rows for those agents' windows in `useStatus().usage.windows`: `<agentName> · 5h` (or `weekly`, or the window's label), the used percent such as `41%`, and `resets …` while the reset is ahead.
  - a footer that names `terminalx sessions usage` and copies `terminalx sessions usage <id> --json`, and an `Open Stats` button that closes the popover and calls `openStats()`.
notes:
Source: PR #896 (PRO-273), five commits, all on the per-session usage path.
Chain: 4f326c36 introduces the per-tab usage records (src-tauri/src/session_usage.rs, the index fields, sessions usage in cli.rs/control.rs), the sessionCost experimental switch, src/lib/experimentalSettings.ts and src/components/session/SessionCost.tsx in SessionView.tsx. fe213d6c changes SessionCost.tsx and its place in SessionView.tsx, adds scripts/webkit/session-cost.mjs, and fixes the Codex reading in stats/mod.rs that the first commit prices with. 4a1888c3 changes SessionCost.tsx's popover heading again and adds session-cost.mjs to package.json's WebKit layout checks. c8193619 reworks session_usage.rs and stats (transcripts followed incrementally in the new stats/followed.rs, repeated Codex totals) and changes SessionCost.tsx for partial estimates. 6ff3e710 updates the phone settings test in local_runtime/mobile_create_tests.rs for the sessionCost switch the first commit added to the experimental payload.
Every later commit edits files the first one created or changed.
Replaying only these five commits onto startCommit passes the check, so it does not depend on what main merged into the branch.
The check is the PR's SessionCost.test.tsx. The Rust half (session_usage_tests.rs, the control test for sessions.usage) is not checked.
